critical_issues.msg: Rule 53: search_customers passes user input directly into ilike without escaping SQL wildcards. An empty keyword or crafted input like '%' will match all records, bypassing intent.
critical_issues.suggestion: Escape '%' and '_' in keyword before building the pattern, e.g.: kw = keyword.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('%', '\\%').replace('_', '\\_') + '%'

critical_issues.msg: Rule 123: bulk_import calls session.flush() but never refreshes the objects, so auto-generated IDs are never populated on the inserted CustomerModel instances. Any caller relying on returned IDs gets None.
critical_issues.suggestion: Call await self.session.refresh(customer) for each customer after flush, or track inserted IDs via a separate SELECT after flush.

critical_issues.msg: Rule 122 / project convention: The test asserts that session.commit is called in the service, but services must only flush — never commit. The router layer owns the transaction boundary. This test encodes an incorrect expectation.
critical_issues.suggestion: Remove the commit assertion. Replace with: mock_db_session.flush.assert_called_once() — matching the correct service behavior.

suggestions.msg: Rule 85: tags parameter is accepted but never used — customers are never filtered by tags despite being listed in the function signature.
suggestions.suggestion: Either implement the tags filter or remove the parameter to avoid misleading callers.

suggestions.msg: Rule 57: Error message uses hardcoded Chinese string '客户' instead of English, inconsistent with the rest of the service.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a consistent English identifier, e.g. NotFoundException('Customer').

suggestions.msg: Rule 57: Error message uses hardcoded Chinese string '客户' instead of English.
Rule 33: search_customers always uses a hard-coded limit of 100 with no pagination — callers cannot page through large result sets.
suggestions.suggestion: Add optional page/page_size parameters to search_customers, matching the pattern used in list_customers.

suggestions.msg: Rule 27: VALID_STATUSES is a class-level set of strings but the service also imports and uses models.customer.CustomerStatus (an Enum). These two sets are not reconciled — a status valid by one may be invalid by the other.
suggestions.suggestion: Derive VALID_STATUSES from CustomerStatus members, or remove the duplicate validation layer.

suggestions.msg: Rule 66: mock_db_session fixture wires fetchall and all on the same mock result, but the actual service only uses .all() for count_by_status. fetchall wiring is dead code.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the fetchall mock line; it is not exercised by any test.

suggestions.msg: Rule 8: sys.path.insert at module level is a fragile workaround — it duplicates the role of PYTHONPATH and breaks if tests are run from different working directories.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the sys.path manipulation and set PYTHONPATH=src in pytest.ini or pyproject.toml under [tool.pytest.ini_options].

suggestions.msg: Rule 66 / project convention: mock_db_session wires commit as AsyncMock, but commit must never be called from services — this mocks the wrong call. AsyncMock on commit can mask the bug where a service incorrectly calls commit.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove session.commit from the fixture entirely. If a test needs to verify flush-not-commit, a no-op MagicMock for commit is more honest than AsyncMock.
